evals.name: links-written-as-reference-links
evals.prompt: /ideate 根据 docs/requirements/raw.md 整理产品构想
evals.expected_output: raw.md confirms every required field and gives 4 URLs plus one local research note cited by both research targets. Writes docs/ideas/idea.md where every link is a collapsed reference link `[text][]`, the research note is defined once, definitions sit at the file end after `---` grouped under HTML comments (local file group first, then URL groups), and each research item carries a 调研记录 line. Deletes raw.md after migration.
expectations: Both research items have a `调研记录：` line pointing to the same reference
Definitions are at the end of idea.md, local file group before URL groups, each under an HTML comment
Every `[text][]` reference has exactly one definition and every definition is referenced
Only the URLs from raw.md appear; no searched or guessed links are added

evals.name: no-links-no-definition-block
evals.prompt: /ideate 根据 docs/requirements/raw.md 整理产品构想
evals.expected_output: raw.md confirms every required field, no research and no technical references. Writes idea.md with `> 无` under sections 3 and 4 and leaves out the link definitions block entirely.
expectations: idea.md has no link definition lines and no link-group HTML comments
idea.md has no leftover template placeholders such as `<链接文本>` or `<URL>`
